# Thinking, Fast and Slow

By Kahneman.

- I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day.
- Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later.
- Lent my copy to Iris, ask for it back in Wednesday meeting.
- Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories.
- The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked.
- The main argument is that small habits compound over years.
- Iris recommended it after our conversation about focus.
- The writing is clear and the examples are memorable.
